sloka: घातैर्जानुप्रहारैश्च दशनानां च पातनैः ।भक्षणैः कर्णनासानां केशानां लुञ्चनैस्तथा ।। ६.११६.३५ ।।
transliteration: ghātairjānuprahāraiśca daśanānāṁ ca pātanaiḥ ।bhakṣaṇaiḥ karṇanāsānāṁ keśānāṁ luñcanaistathā ।। 6.116.35 ।।

translations.english: "I wish to kill by all kinds of strokes, these cruel distorted forms of Rakshasas having terrible hair and fierce eyes and not to mention their violence. Permit me."
